description: A link for the PERSON to open: live prices for their exact dates and needs, ranked by the total they will actually pay, where they can book. Use whenever the person has dates and wants to see or book cars.

age.description: Main driver's age in years (default 35). Under 25 or over 70 often costs more.

airport.description: Airport id, IATA code or name, e.g. 'faro', 'FAO', 'Faro Airport'

car_type.description: Car size; omit for every size.

debit_card.description: True if the driver has no credit card - only cars whose desk takes a debit card for the deposit.

extra_driver.description: True if a second driver will drive - their fee is then in every total.

place.description: Any city/place if not a measured airport

residence.description: Two-letter country of residence, e.g. GB

name: build_search_link
title: Build search link
